close_reason: Superseded by audit 2026-05-11. Profile/ValidationPolicy/ValidatedPath/Error already serve the foundational-types role. Identity-binding work (.11/.12) extends ValidationPolicy and Error variants instead of introducing new trait.
description:
Foundational types for the verify pipeline. Sits at the base of all `policies::*` impls.

**Deliverable:** `pkix-chain/src/policy.rs` (or similar) exposing:

- `pub trait VerificationPolicy { fn id(&self) -> &str; fn evaluate(&self, ctx: &PathContext) -> Vec<Finding>; }`
- `pub struct PathContext<'a> { /* built_path: &'a [Certificate], time, trust_anchors, ... */ }`
- `pub struct Finding { source, severity, message, evidence, cert_index }`
- `pub enum Severity { Error, Warn, Notice, Info }`
- `pub enum FindingSource { PathValidation, Revocation, PurposeBinding(&'static str), Profile(ProfileId), Lint(LintId) }`
- `pub struct Evidence` per `.5` decision

Test surface:
- Trait-object stacking compiles and runs.
- Basic `Finding` construction and equality.
- `PathContext` exposes the path index and trust anchor lookup.

**Blocks on:** .1 (must ratify the trait shape first).
title: Implement VerificationPolicy trait + PathContext + Finding types
